remarks: Charming studio bedroom rental literally steps from downtown Westport. There is NOT a separate bedroom (contrary to what the third party sites say). Just renovated with new appliances (frig is a few years old). Sorry, no laundry access in the apartment or building. And yes, you read that correctly: electricity, heat and hot water ARE included in the rent. It's great opportunity to get situated in Westport and have everything close to you. Sorry, pets will not be permitted and the same to smoking. Good credit is a must. For credit reports & rental applications: zumper dot com forward slash tenant-screening?agentId=322337
